title: EVA-Cap: Optimizing Audiovisual Video Captioning via Event-Centric Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.22186v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in Omni Language Models (OLMs) provide a unified solution for audiovisual video captioning. Nevertheless, existing approaches predominantly treat captioning as an unstructured text generation process, neglecting the inherent semantic structure of videos and leading to suboptimal fine-grained audiovisual alignment. To bridge this gap, we propose EVA-Cap, a novel framework that decomposes captions into atomic audiovisual events and transforms unstructured text supervision into event-centric alignment. We train EVA-Cap via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on a self-curated dataset, EVA-Data, which is built with event-centric quality control. During the GRPO phase, the model is explicitly optimized against three event-centric alignment targets: global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization. translated_title: EVA-Cap：通过以事件为中心的对齐优化视听视频描述生成
translated_abstract: 全模态语言模型（OLMs）的最新进展为视听视频描述生成提供了一种统一的解决方案。然而，现有方法大多将描述生成视为非结构化的文本生成过程，忽视了视频固有的语义结构，导致细粒度的视听对齐效果欠佳。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 EVA-Cap，这是一种新颖的框架，它将描述文本分解为原子化的视听事件，并将非结构化的文本监督转化为以事件为中心的对齐。我们在自建数据集 EVA-Data 上，通过监督微调（SFT）和群体相对策略优化（GRPO）训练 EVA-Cap，该数据集基于以事件为中心的质量控制构建而成。在 GRPO 阶段，模型针对三个以事件为中心的对齐目标进行显式优化：全局事件完整性、事件内属性归因以及事件间同步性。大量实验表明，EVA-Cap 显著……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出EVA-Cap框架，将视频描述分解为原子化视听事件，并在自建数据集EVA-Data上通过SFT与GRPO针对全局事件完整性、事件内属性归因和事件间同步三个事件中心对齐目标进行优化，从而提升全模态模型的视听视频描述质量。
en_tdlr: EVA-Cap is a novel framework that decomposes video captions into atomic audiovisual events and trains Omni Language Models via SFT and GRPO against three event-centric alignment targets—global event completeness, intra-event attribution, and inter-event synchronization—to improve audiovisual video captioning.
